original_text: Looking for longitudinal plasma metabolomics cohorts in Alzheimer's disease, at least 200 patients, for biomarker validation. We want to minimise statin effects and need commercial-use rights.
scope_notes: Buyer requires longitudinal plasma metabolomics cohorts in Alzheimer's disease for biomarker validation, with a minimum of 200 usable participants and confirmed commercial-use rights. Statin confounding is an explicit concern — prioritise cohorts that either exclude statin users or document statin use as a covariate.

gaps.reason: User stated 'need commercial-use rights' directly, so commercial_use=true is given, not inferred. However, no specific licensing framework (e.g. MTA, data sharing agreement type) was specified — discover should surface access route and licensing terms for each cohort.

User said 'metabolomics' without specifying targeted vs. untargeted or platform (e.g. LC-MS, NMR). filter_for_discover includes lipidomics and untargeted metabolomics as adjacent matches; flag if only targeted panels are available.
Not stated. Discover will surface options without filtering by cost.

MCI (mild cognitive impairment) and prodromal AD cohorts were not mentioned. These are adjacent and commonly co-enrolled in AD metabolomics studies — not included in filter_for_discover by default; buyer should confirm whether MCI conversion sub-cohorts are acceptable.
